description: Transmission Line Fault using Line Voltages and Currents as Features is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Paul Michael Custodio, Dong-Seong Kim (Department of IT Convergence Engineering, Kumoh National Institute of Technology). Different faults are experienced by a power system, particulary in transmission lines. In this dataset, the IEEE 5-Bus Model was used to different types of transmission line faults.Indication of the label of the faults come from the time that the fault has been induced in the simulation.This dataset aims to be utilized for machine learning ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
